name: SBS Radio Clips
summary: Turn a long SBS Radio episode into editable vertical shorts in the program's own format, with headlines and captions.

compatibility.selects: Requires Panel SDK runScript/runShell/askAI, the selects.files panel file service (YouTube links, saved templates and progress), Project importFiles and startAnalysis, and Draft setFrameSize, splitAt, setClipTransform and addMotionGraphic. On Windows the yt-dlp steps run in cmd.exe and full-quality downloads use the ffmpeg bundled with Selects. Face following (on for News Direct) needs selects.ai (Selects 2.0.560 or later) and selects-ai-runtime from the same library revision, plus the Microsoft Visual C++ 2019-or-newer x64 runtime on Windows; without them clips keep the fixed crop. Built from Chosun Ilbo TikTok Clips 0.1.0-alpha.3; checked on Selects Staging 2.0.661 on macOS; Windows x64 not yet run on a Windows host.
